assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production-quality transparent 3D illustration for Sunil B.K / GORKcoder's dark MERN developer portfolio. A single sculptural object, centered on a square composition, complete silhouette with generous transparent margins. Refined editorial CGI, tactile materials, soft studio key light from upper left, realistic depth and highlights designed to read on charcoal #13161c. Brushed aluminum and ivory details. Strong simple silhouette, not cluttered. Truly transparent alpha background; no environment, no pedestal, no floor, no background color, no background glow, no text, no captions, no watermark. No translucent glass. Camera: gentle three-quarter front view, object fills about 75% of the frame. Subject BUILD: a beautifully crafted React atom sculpture with three intersecting thick softly rounded cyan #92d8df orbital bands and an ivory central sphere. Small brushed-metal code angle-bracket pair and a compact three-tier database cylinder sit connected to the base of the atom as one balanced full-stack assembly. Cyan resin with satin finish, precision aluminum accents. Keep the recognizable React atom uncluttered and dominant. No loose particles, no flat icon, no UI mockup.
